Sentence (English): We purchased our new bosch dishwasher during a sale at Lowes in July 2024.
Comments (English): [ Pleased With Our Bosch ] || ---------------- || We purchased our new bosch dishwasher during a sale at Lowes in July 2024. We really love the interior design of this dishwasher; the overall size, adjustable middle rack (that can go up, down, AND angle left or right), the third rack for utensils, and the fact that there is no heating element so you can safely put plastics on the bottom. The Auto-Air feature is also great. It is SO quiet and we love using the app for wash statistics as well as getting live updates during cycles (never thought I'd like to use a 'smart appliance'). I do wish that the button interface on the door was a little more intuitive (if you select the wrong program and hit "start", the only way I've found to cancel it is by using the app. restarting/reseting doesn't typically work). I would knock a star off but most likely it's just user error not knowing exactly what to do. The door may also stick if it becomes dirty so be sure to keep the seal around the dishwasher clean, but that should go for any dishwasher/appliance. I do highly recommend this dishwasher as a great option.

Sentence (English): This is a very different dishwasher than my previous one.
Comments (English): [ Very different but good ] || ---------------- || This is a very different dishwasher than my previous one. I love the silverware rack, it holds a lot more, is more flexible, and and gets everything clean compared to my previous one. I was concered about not having a heated dry cycle but it has been a non-issue. The only thing I'm still adjusting to is the layout of the tines. My old dishwasher had a grid of vertical tines which gave flexibility for loading it. The angled tines and spacing on this one limits what I can put where. I use a lot of Pyrex storage containers and they're deeper than this was designed for so they can't stand up straight even with every other tine folded down and end up taking up a lot of space or prevent other rows from being used. In my old dishwasher they could stand between the rows of tines easily. It washes things great but things other than plates/bowls just end up going in more haphazard and not as efficiently than I would like.

Sentence (English): I'm very happy with how clean my dishes come out.
Comments (English): [ ADA model pros and cons ] || ---------------- || I'm very happy with how clean my dishes come out. The machine is also pretty quiet. But there is no good way to load bowls. If you have more than 3 bowls, you lose over half the space for plates or glasses/mugs. The one main issue that should have been mentioned in the product description before purchase is that this model comes with a built in water softener that requires a special dishwasher salt. To use the machine, you must know what your water hardness is, and that is not easy to find out. Come to find out, water testing strips are not accurate. I had to make many calls to the water department, City, and water quality lab, and then we had to figure out how to convert their measurement units to what Bosch uses. The Bosch manual warns of damage to the machine if you don't set this up correctly if your water is anything but the softest on the measurement scale. I knew my water is definitely not soft, and who wants to risk damage to a $1000 new machine! I bought my machine at Home Depot, and they knew nothing about any of this when I went back to ask. They also don't sell the dishwasher salt. I was able to order the salt on Amazon, but even with Amazon Prime, delivery time was 3 days. By the time I got the salt and set up my machine to use for the first time, only to find out the detergent and rinse aid dispenser was defective, it was beyond the 48 hours Home Depot covers to fix any issues. So then I had to call Bosch and wait for them to send someone to replace the defective dispenser which took over a week. Pretty frustrating, but at least now the machine works well.

Sentence (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Sentence (English): It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Sentence (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Sentence (English): The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Sentence (English): Smart functions and management convenience.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. Sentence (English): The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes.
Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Comments (English): While looking for a dishwasher to reduce housework time in my busy daily life, I chose the LG Dios Objet Collection model. It is a very satisfactory product that provides excellent performance and convenience beyond my expectations. Sophisticated design and space utilization. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is not just a simple home appliance, but also an excellent kitchen interior element. The minimalistic yet luxurious design and calming color matched the kitchen atmosphere well, and after installation, the kitchen felt more neat and tidy. It is also designed to be slimmer than a regular dishwasher, so it can be installed without burden in a small kitchen, and it boasts a spacious storage space for 12 people, so it can be used sufficiently in a household with many families. Excellent cleaning power. The cleaning power of the LG Dios dishwasher was particularly impressive. The high-temperature cleaning and quadruple water system worked powerfully, so I was able to clean the dishes without any remaining oil or water stains after washing. It was also very satisfactory in terms of hygiene because it effectively removes bacteria and germs using high-temperature water. Even dishes and frying pans with dried food on them were cleaned cleanly without washing them by hand, so I was able to use various types of dishes without any problems. Smart sensor and convenient automatic setting. The smart sensor function was also very useful. The smart sensor automatically detects the level of contamination of the dishes and adjusts the washing intensity, so it was possible to perform optimal washing according to the situation without the hassle of selecting a washing program every time. Thanks to this, water and electricity were saved and user convenience was increased. In addition, energy efficiency was excellent because the washing time was adjusted according to the amount of dishes. Various washing modes and drying functions. The LG Dios Objet dishwasher had various washing modes, so I could choose according to my needs. When strong washing was needed, I could use the 'power washing mode', and when delicate washing such as glasses was needed, I could use the 'delicate washing mode', which was useful. In particular, the 'steam drying' function at the end dried the dishes fluffy after washing, and they were clean without leaving water marks. Low noise and energy saving due to the inverter motor. The LG dishwasher was impressive because it made almost no noise while operating by using an inverter motor. Since the kitchen is close to the living room, products that are noisy can be uncomfortable, but LG products were very quiet and did not disturb my life while in use. It was quiet and energy-saving, so it consumed less power, and I was satisfied with it as an eco-friendly product that took the environment into consideration. Smart functions and management convenience. LG's smart functions also stood out. You can check the washing progress in real time through the smartphone app, and you can control it remotely while you're out, so you can easily control it anytime, anywhere. In particular, it was convenient because it notified me when the washing was done, so I didn't forget to clean the dishes. The filters and internal parts can be easily removed and attached, so they are easy to clean and hygienically managed, which was also an advantage. Overall review. The LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher is a product that combines a sophisticated design, ample capacity, powerful cleaning power, and various modes. Thanks to the smart sensor and inverter motor, it is efficient and convenient, so the whole family can use it with satisfaction. With its low-noise operation, excellent drying performance, and smart functions, it is a product that can be recommended as a high-end dishwasher for home use.

Sentence (English): We have been using the Bosch dishwasher for 5 months, now!
Comments (English): [ Cleans and Dries,,,,, well almost! ] || ---------------- || We have been using the Bosch dishwasher for 5 months, now! Overall, we like it, but it has some quirks. The setup was easy, a little challenging getting the water connection due to the tight space and trying to tighten with your hand. The utensil rack is smaller than previous we have had, but works out fine. We do have some forks that have a wider handle, so it is a little tight getting those in, and unless you lift the top of the utensil organizer rack up, you can't place them tines down, also not a big deal. The top center rack is adjustable for various heights of glasses, dishes, pans, etc. on both the lower rack or the upper third flatware rack. The third rack is great for flatware that is too tall for the utensil rack. Takes some getting used to as far as preferred loading of plates and other cookware, but arn't most? There is a setting to place more washing power toward the back or front, or you can customize this setting, but have not played with that yet. A couple of my major cons include the lack of a heating element for the drying process, it uses superheated water as a final rinse, if I understand it correctly. Due to this, we always have water sitting on some items that need hand drying before storing items back in the cabinet. Typically, we will just prop the door open after the cycle is complete to give it a chance to air dry a little more. This model lacks auto-open door when the cycle is complete, like others do. The last con, I downloaded the app and setup wifi to be able to initiate a delayed wash. We typically like to run it during the night, and, yes, it is that quiet! Plus we are on a time of use electric plan and like to run certain appliances during the lowest electric rate. Worked great for a month, then could no longer get it to work. Tried reconnecting to the network, but no go. Contacted support, and they were fairly quick to reply. Providing a few ideas to get it to connect, and if that did not work, they were working on a firmware update. So, hopefully, that is soon. The filter at the bottom is easily removed to clean, which we do monthly. No rinsing of dishes is necessary and if you have a pan with baked on food particles, we'll run it with the heavy duty setting and direct the power wash to that area, and 90% of the time it will be clean. Total water use is around 4-5 gallons per cycle. the stainless finish is easily maintained and fingerprints are not an issue.

We did notice that the capacity is smaller than our previous unit (different manufacturer) and the configuration of the racks take some getting used to. The top rack slide bracket system seems much lighter and pulling the rack out is not as smooth. Also without adding the extra dry feature to the normal cycle many dishes do still hold water. It would be nice if at the completion of the cycle that the clean indicator light would stay on until the clean dishes are attended to.That said we did choose Bosch over many compeditors because of your reputation for a well built quality product with low maintainance.

Sentence (English): Media Electric Dishwasher 3-person Orange!
Comments (English): Media Electric Dishwasher 3-person Orange! Delivery arrived in just one day after ordering! When I received the delivery and looked at the box, I was surprised that it was bigger than I thought, but when I opened the box. The dishwasher was safely packed with thick styrofoam on the top and bottom. The dishwasher is small and cute as expected for a 3-person dishwasher! And because it is orange, my eyes are drawn to the dishwasher when I put it in the kitchen! It's pretty^^ It's a 3-person dishwasher. When I looked at it, I thought the size was good for a single person or a newlywed couple. There are 4 people in my house. It's ambiguous to use. So I only put in the children's dishes, water bottles, cups, cutting boards, spoons, etc. that need to be sterilized. I wash the rest by hand. When I put the dishwasher in, I feel relieved when I do the pre-washing, so it's much more convenient for me to put in the dishwasher pre-wash and wash the rest. Even if you have a 3-4-person household, if it's difficult to install a dishwasher in your house or your house is small, I think it's okay to buy a 3-person dishwasher and use it. Media Electric Dishwasher 3-person. - It is a no-installation dishwasher that eliminates the cumbersome installation process, so I was able to install it by myself without my husband's help. It is not very heavy either! It is easier than you think! - Steam sterilization without worrying about bacteria - Powerful 72-degree high-temperature washing with hot high-temperature water - Drying and storage function of the entire air circulation drying system (I leave the door open and dry after washing is done.) - The water stream created by the powerful water spray and 360-degree rotation sprays water to every corner without any blind spots, so it has excellent washing performance. (I liked that I could see with my own eyes how the dishwasher was being washed inside.) - There are 5 practical washing modes (standard, strong, eco, fast steam). I think you can use the necessary washing mode depending on the situation. I think it would be good to use the steam function for children's dishes, baby bottles, and baby food. - Media said that they will visit you when A/S is needed, so I think I can apply for A/S if there is a problem while using it. I will use it well^^

Sentence (English): My kitchen is small, so it was difficult to fit a 12-place setting dishwasher, but I bought this one because I thought a 6-place setting would fit on top.
Comments (English): [ You can use it comfortably. ] || ---------------- || My kitchen is small, so it was difficult to fit a 12-place setting dishwasher, but I bought this one because I thought a 6-place setting would fit on top. First off, the design is clean. Although my house doesn't really have much in the way of interior decor, I liked that the design is clean enough not to detract from the decor even in a beautifully decorated home. The size was bigger than I expected. I think it needs to be this size to fit dishes in two tiers. Since it has two shelves, it holds quite a few dishes. It seems just right for a family of four. Also, if you want to put in slightly larger dishes or pots, you can remove the top shelf. However, I plan to hand-wash pots; I intend to use it for rice bowls, soup bowls, side dish bowls, and cups. The operation is also very simple and easy. You can select a cycle, set extra rinses or soaks, and even enable automatic door opening. I think the automatic door opening feature is a must-have. After washing with hot water, you need to open the door to release the steam inside to reduce odors. Perhaps because I used it for the first time to make steamed eggs, there was a slight fishy smell. I searched online extensively about this, and there were many suggestions, such as cleaning the dishwasher or changing the detergent. Since it is a new product, I don't think cleaning or maintenance is the issue. However, I heard that eggs, milk, and dairy products tend to cause a fishy smell more easily, so I plan to try washing it again with a different detergent. The dishes came out squeaky clean. Sentence (English): I was debating whether to give 3 or 4 stars, but the performance of this dishwasher compared to my old Darby model is so much better I decided to go with 4.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Compact Dishwasher, but not perfect. ] || ---------------- || I was debating whether to give 3 or 4 stars, but the performance of this dishwasher compared to my old Darby model is so much better I decided to go with 4. First, the good stuff: this unit is QUIET! That's a real plus. Dishes come out consistently clean, although (as with most dishwashers this side) the contents usually require a bit of air drying to get fully dry. Now the bad: All the controls are located on the top of the door, which means they are inaccessible when the door is closed. This means you can't see how much time is left on a cycle while the unit is running. Also, it is really easy to accidentally hit a control, which could make the unit use more water and increase cycle time unintentionally. My wife actually accidentally activated the lock controls feature and we had to read the online manual to figure out how to get the unit unlocked (there is an indicator on the door, but you really don't understand what it means unless you read the manual). There is an audible beep when the dishwasher finishes, but if you are in another part of the house you might not hear it, which is why a display with a timer on the front would be really helpful. Finally, the front of the unit is really prone to fingerprints. It cleans easily enough, but you need to wipe it down pretty much after every use (or just put up with the smudges). So this is a weak 4-star review. A 3.5, really. If it had a display on the front I would give it a solid 4, and maybe more if the front wasn't so prone to getting smudged up.

First, the good stuff: this unit is QUIET! That's a real plus. Dishes come out consistently clean, although (as with most dishwashers this side) the contents usually require a bit of air drying to get fully dry. Now the bad: All the controls are located on the top of the door, which means they are inaccessible when the door is closed. This means you can't see how much time is left on a cycle while the unit is running. Also, it is really easy to accidentally hit a control, which could make the unit use more water and increase cycle time unintentionally. My wife actually accidentally activated the lock controls feature and we had to read the online manual to figure out how to get the unit unlocked (there is an indicator on the door, but you really don't understand what it means unless you read the manual). There is an audible beep when the dishwasher finishes, but if you are in another part of the house you might not hear it, which is why a display with a timer on the front would be really helpful. Finally, the front of the unit is really prone to fingerprints. It cleans easily enough, but you need to wipe it down pretty much after every use (or just put up with the smudges). So this is a weak 4-star review. A 3.5, really. If it had a display on the front I would give it a solid 4, and maybe more if the front wasn't so prone to getting smudged up.

Sentence (English): After using the dishwasher for about a week, I still have a few programs to try, but I can say that so far the results of the washes are very satisfactory.
Comments (English): [ Happy but I miss a short cycle ] || ---------------- || After using the dishwasher for about a week, I still have a few programs to try, but I can say that so far the results of the washes are very satisfactory. The dishwasher has 5 wash programs (Auto, Intensive, Eco, Turbo and Cleaning) and depending on the wash, it has a different water and energy consumption as you can see in one of the attached images. The Turbo program lasts 59 minutes but if you don't use the drying option, which I don't recommend because all the dishes get wet. With the drying option, it increases to 1 hour and 40 minutes. The Eco, although it lasts the longest, to my surprise, is the one that consumes the least water and electricity. You can select the dishwasher load by cleaning only the upper or lower tray, or both. I'm still waiting to try the auto program, which from what I've seen in the instructions, adapts its time and consumption to the dirt detected in the water, so its duration is variable. I have the slight feeling that it has a little more capacity than my previous dishwasher, this may be due to the multitude of positions that both trays have, having space for glasses or for large pans/pots by modifying the position of the rods. We are 4 people living at home and the full load arrives in approximately 3 days, although this is not a relevant fact since it also depends on the optimization of the space that each one makes. The cutlery basket can be put in multiple positions which also optimizes space and the upper tray has two height positions. I can lock the panel so that my little son does not spend all day using it since the sound it makes when turning it on and off is very striking (it can be removed). Another thing that can be configured is the water hardness to have optimal washing results. In short, I am happy but I miss a short program.
Comments (Original): [ Contenta pero echo en falta un ciclo corto ] || ---------------- || Después de estar usando el lavavajillas durante aproximadamente una semana aun me quedan algunos programas por probar pero puedo decir que por ahora los resultados de los lavados son muy satisfactorios. El lavavajillas tiene 5 programas de lavado (Auto, Intensivo, Eco, turbo y limpieza) y dependiendo del lavado que sea Tiene un consumo de agua y energía diferente según podéis ver en una de las imágenes que adjunto. El programa Turbo dura 59 min pero si no se usa la opción de secado, que no recomiendo porque queda toda la vajilla húmeda. Con la opción de secado aumenta a 1 hora y 40 min. El eco aunque es el que más dura, para mi sorpresa es el que menos consume tanto agua como electricidad. Se puede seleccionar la carga de lavavajillas haciendo solo limpieza de bandeja superior, inferior o ambas. Tengo pendiente a probar el programa auto, que por lo que he visto en las instrucciones, adapta su tiempo y consumo a la suciedad que se detecte en el agua por lo que su duración es variable. Tengo la ligera sensación de que tiene un poco mas de capacidad que mi anterior lavavajillas, esto puede ser debido a la multitud de posición de la que disponen ambas bandejas teniendo espacio para las copas o para sartenes/ollas de gran volumen modificando la posición de las varillas. En casa somos 4 personas viviendo y llego la carga completa en aproximadamente 3 días, aunque esto no es un dato relevante ya que también depende de la optimización del espacio que haga cada uno. La cesta de los cubiertos se puede poner en múltiples posiciones lo que optimiza también el espacio y la bandeja superior tiene dos posiciones en altura. Puedo bloquear el panel para que mi hijo pequeño no ande todo el día poniéndolo en funcionamiento ya que el sonido que emite al encender y apagar es muy llamativo (se puede quitar). Otra cosa que se puede configurar es la dureza del agua para tener así resultados óptimos de lavado. En resumidas cuentas, estoy contenta pero echo de menos un programa corto.

Sentence (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Washer, Minor Issues ] || ---------------- || This is my second Bosch dishwasher. Got my first in 2008. Got this new one in 2024. I could complain about the last one, but this model fixed many of my old issues. So, great start! Added a couple new, small issues, though. I love the third rack. Didn't have that before. Very quiet. Very easy to get a wash cycle started. Gets dishes very clean. The detergent pods are convenient. So far, so good. I love having the app. I really did not think I would, but I do. I forgot to start my washer Monday morning, so I used the app to start it from work. I also love knowing when a cycle ends. Quite nice to have all those options right there. Very nice! I installed the dishwasher myself. Very easy to do. Only had to go to the hardware store for a water line adapter one time. Last thing. I LOVE the Auto Air option. Love it! The door opens on its own when a cycle ends to aid in drying the dishes. What a great idea! Now, some downsides. I don't like that a cycle in progress will not resume on its own after I open then close the door. I have to press the Play button again, which gets annoying. Wish it would just resume when I close the door all by itself. A minor thing. Also, the app was difficult to get set up. I work with tech, so it wasn't terrible for me, but I can only imagine how hard it would be for someone not used to dealing with odd tech. Once the app is set up, I love it. Getting it set up was not easy, though. Also, I don't like that some options are only available in the app. On my old washer, I could delay start with a button. If there is a button for delay start on this model, I don't know where it is. It might be my own ignorance speaking here, but I genuinely don't see it. I would give this a 5 out of 5 except for those three minor issues. At any rate, I would definitely recommend this unit to anyone. And my brother who fixes appliances for a living swears by Bosch. Good enough for him, good enough for me. Like I said, been with Bosch since '08.

Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher. with a couple of caveats ] || ---------------- || So we've had this dishwasher for a few months now and it's a really good dishwasher. It cleans everything off that we've thrown at it. even stuff baked onto the pan. However a couple of things need to be addressed. Putting plastic containers inside is ok but they have to be held down so that they are not blown around by force of water. There's nothing inside the dishwasher that will hold plastic containers down. The other small issue is that the buttons to select cycle are 'finicky' or 'touchy'. Sometimes when pressed, they work first time but other times requires more than one press for it to be recognized by Dishwasher. Not a big deal but is frustrating sometimes. All in all a really good dishwasher and I would recommend it to anyone.

Sentence (English): I've had the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher for a few months now, and it's easily the best kitchen upgrade I've made.
Comments (English): [ Paying for quality ] || ---------------- || I've had the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher for a few months now, and it's easily the best kitchen upgrade I've made. The sleek, stainless-steel design blends perfectly with my modern kitchen, but what really impresses me is the ultra-quiet operation—at just 42 dBA, I often forget it's even running! The flexible interior is a huge bonus. With its three racks, I can easily load everything from tall pots to delicate wine glasses without running out of space. The RackMatic system is a game-changer for accommodating larger items, and the top rack is perfect for cutlery and smaller pieces. In terms of cleaning, this dishwasher really delivers. The PrecisionWash system adjusts water flow based on the load, and I've yet to find a spot or stain left behind, even on my toughest dishes. I love the Extra Dry option for plastics—everything comes out dry and ready to put away, no extra towel-drying needed. It has several cycles for heavy-duty loads, quick washes, and even a delicate option, so I always have the right setting for any type of dish. The Home Connect app is surprisingly useful. I can start the dishwasher remotely, and it notifies me when the cycle is done, which is super convenient for a busy household. While it's a bit pricier than other options, the performance, quietness, and smart features make it well worth the investment. If you're looking for a high-performing, quiet, and thoughtfully designed dishwasher, I highly recommend the Bosch 800 Series.

Sentence (English): I find this dishwasher control panel confusing and the unit difficult to load.
Comments (English): [ Not Perfect ] || ---------------- || I find this dishwasher control panel confusing and the unit difficult to load. The control panel has a "reset" button which I assume is the "cancel" button as well since the start button is labeled "start/resume". None of the buttons on the top are actually raised or emit a noise when touched so I'm not sure if the "button" is actually depressed. My old dishwasher had an electronic panel like this one but when you "touched the buttons" there was an audible tone. The Bosch videos are quite helpful especially since there is relatively no instruction manual on how to use the dishwasher. Unfortunately, I have recently had several occasions where the dishwasher turns on without even touching the control panel or selecting the start/resume button. I'm beginning to wonder if there is a problem beginning to brew with the unit. My dishwasher has the controls on the top with a custom door panel on the front so I'm absolutely sure I am not touching the control panel by accident which would cause it to turn on. This unit is extremely quiet which is a plus. In addition, I have the added advantage of a light that illuminates the floor during the cycle. This light is usually how I know that the dishwasher has turned on accidently. I also find that dishes need to be in specific areas or they don't fit properly. I am still working on finding where and how to load my dishes properly. Watching the videos have understand the dishwasher better. This dishwasher cleans the dishes quite well. I have found that I need to select "crystal dry" which is an extended drying feature in order for it to dry the dishes to the level I prefer. Since this unit cleans the dishes well, is quiet, and dries the dishes well on the crystal dry feature I would say that it overall it is a good unit.

Sentence (English): We recently purchased a Bosch 800 dishwasher to replace our 24-year-old Bosch dishwasher, which we loved.
Comments (English): [ Disapponted with Bosch 800 Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We recently purchased a Bosch 800 dishwasher to replace our 24-year-old Bosch dishwasher, which we loved. I am very, very disappointed with our new purchase. The layout of the racks is terrible. In the upper rack: (1) The old model had "fold down" plastic pieces that made it super-easy to add a second layer of coffee cups. In the new one, these "fold UP" . so if you've placed cups there, you can't later decide to fold up to and create more capacity, unless you remove the cups that were already in place. And if you fold up in anticipation of that need, it's almost impossible to place cups under the folded-up pieces. Further, the fold-down process was super-easy, but the new fold-up ones must be pulled forward and snapped into place. (2) The spacing between the "bumps" along the cup-row was perfect - but now, they're too far apart to achieve full use of the space. (3) In the 800 model, the row for placing bowls is too close to the side - impossible to place cups/glasses in the space between the bowls and the side of the rack, even tough our bowls are very small diameter. In the lower rack: (4) The "large plate" and "small plate" racks used to run side-to side. Now the large plate runs side-to-side, but the small plate racks are perpendicular. As a result, if you want to put a long item (say, a cutting board) in the large plate rack, it extends into the small plate rack, and greatly reduces the number of small plates that can be placed in the rack. Also, (5) the two parallel small-plate racks are too close together - if you try to fill them both with small plates, the plates bang together in the middle; none have broken yet, but I expect chips in the future. Finally, (6) despite the "crystal dry" feature, the dishwasher does a terrible job of drying (note: this may be due in part to energy-use restrictions, but the crystal-dry feature does not live up to the advertising hype).

In the upper rack: (1) The old model had "fold down" plastic pieces that made it super-easy to add a second layer of coffee cups. In the new one, these "fold UP" . so if you've placed cups there, you can't later decide to fold up to and create more capacity, unless you remove the cups that were already in place. And if you fold up in anticipation of that need, it's almost impossible to place cups under the folded-up pieces. Further, the fold-down process was super-easy, but the new fold-up ones must be pulled forward and snapped into place. (2) The spacing between the "bumps" along the cup-row was perfect - but now, they're too far apart to achieve full use of the space. (3) In the 800 model, the row for placing bowls is too close to the side - impossible to place cups/glasses in the space between the bowls and the side of the rack, even tough our bowls are very small diameter. In the lower rack: (4) The "large plate" and "small plate" racks used to run side-to side. Now the large plate runs side-to-side, but the small plate racks are perpendicular. As a result, if you want to put a long item (say, a cutting board) in the large plate rack, it extends into the small plate rack, and greatly reduces the number of small plates that can be placed in the rack. Also, (5) the two parallel small-plate racks are too close together - if you try to fill them both with small plates, the plates bang together in the middle; none have broken yet, but I expect chips in the future. Finally, (6) despite the "crystal dry" feature, the dishwasher does a terrible job of drying (note: this may be due in part to energy-use restrictions, but the crystal-dry feature does not live up to the advertising hype).

Sentence (English): It is hard to believe that a built in water softener is bleeding edge, yet here we are.
Comments (English): [ At sea with salt ] || ---------------- || It is hard to believe that a built in water softener is bleeding edge, yet here we are. There is essentially no information about it in the instructions. Keep in mind this is before the first cycle. 1) You need to tell the unit that your water has some hardness in order for it to work. 2) We added the salt, but the sensor still said we needed to add salt. Even resetting the unit did nothing. Finally I just dumped some water into the salt compartment and that made it happy. Nothing in the troubleshooting either about "priming" the salt system with water. BTW, I started a cycle and let it run for 30 min and it still said I needed to add salt. I'm not sure when it first decides to send water into the salt compartment. Otherwise, I love it.

Comments (English): [ Quietly washes superbly, but no "finished" light! ] || ---------------- || This unit replaced an elite product that had seen better days, and it meets almost all my expections but for one--there is no light to let you know when the cycle is complete! How ironic that there is an interior light (which I found more helpful than I expected it to be), but in the absence of a "cycle finished" light, I too often discover a dishwasher full of clean items that need to be emptied only at the end of a meal when I want to load up dirty dishes. Unhelpfully, the manual and customer support both tell me that the exterior lights will be on when the unit is running, so I will know things are ready to be unloaded when the lights are not on (or, they fail to mention, the washer needs to be run in the first place). Support also added I could always check my iPhone to see if the washer was done. This is an improvement? If this glaring omission were removed (as I hope will be done in a software update) this is a five star device for sure. It is a wonderfully quiet machine which does such a good job I often let it handle pots (something I would never trust any previous washer with) on a normal cycle, and I get very acceptable results. Drying is well beyond anything I experienced before; even plastic food containers finish up with little to no residual water, thanks not to higher drying temps but rather through the use of an innovative resin that competes for surface water at the end of the cycle. There is also a removable third upper-most drawer which some might find useful for flatware, but I prefer not to use it since it restricts clearance for items below it.

Unhelpfully, the manual and customer support both tell me that the exterior lights will be on when the unit is running, so I will know things are ready to be unloaded when the lights are not on (or, they fail to mention, the washer needs to be run in the first place).  Support also added I could always check my iPhone to see if the washer was done.  This is an improvement?  If this glaring omission were removed (as I hope will be done in a software update) this is a five star device for sure. It is a wonderfully quiet machine which does such a good job I often let it handle pots (something I would never trust any previous washer with) on a normal cycle, and I get very acceptable results.  Drying is well beyond anything I experienced before; even plastic food containers finish up with little to no residual water, thanks not to higher drying temps but rather through the use of an innovative resin that competes for surface water at the end of the cycle.  There is also a removable third upper-most drawer which some might find useful for flatware, but I prefer not to use it since it restricts clearance for items below it.
